name: device-code-google-signin
title: Device code flow with Google sign-in
description: Template: CLI prints a device code, browser opens the device page, account is selected via Google sign-in, code is entered
preconditions: Verify comet-cdp is up (port 9222) — run: comet-cdp status
Verify the CLI tool is installed and available in PATH
Run: <cli> login --device — it prints a URL and a XXXX-XXXXX code

vars.name: account
vars.description: Account email to select. Use --account shortcut or pass full email.

vars.name: user_code
vars.description: Device code from the CLI output (format XXXX-XXXXX). Optional — if absent, flow skips code entry.

steps.rationale: Open the device authorization page — redirects to the account chooser
Account chooser is shown — check if the desired account is listed
steps.condition: page shows 'Welcome back' heading with account buttons

then.rationale: Account is in the chooser — click it directly
then.condition: the desired account '{{account}}' is visible as a 'Select account' button

otherwise.rationale: Account not in chooser — go to the log-in/sign-up page
otherwise.ref_hint: link containing 'Log in to another account'

otherwise.rationale: The sign-up page shows 'Continue with Google' and other providers
Google account chooser — lists all signed-in Google accounts

then.rationale: After account selection — should be on the consent screen
Consent screen granting the CLI tool access
Approve the consent — redirects to the device code entry page

steps.rationale: Should now be on the code entry page with individual textboxes
Enter the device code if code boxes are visible and a code was provided

then.rationale: Type character 1 of the code (without dash)
Verify code is filled and Continue is enabled

steps.rationale: Verify success — page should show confirmation
Wait for the CLI to write its auth token

success_signal: Page shows 'Signed in' or auth token file appears
